methodHandling.otherMethods: Not checked; any method served like GET.

checkOrder: 4. readJobState(deckId) from blob store 'deck-jobs' key job/{deckId}.json, normalized (404 'Deck not found' if absent)
5. done slides = slides with status 'done', each at currentVersion(s) (current || max(versions.v) || version || 1), sorted numerically (400 'No finished slides to export' if none)
6. for each: readSlideImage(deckId, n, version); missing blob -> skipped silently; embedPng; page [w,h]
8. filename from deck title; fire-and-forget incrementExportCounts; 200

responses.when: at least one done slide has a readable PNG
responses.bodyShape: multi-page PDF, one full-bleed page per done slide (numeric order) sized to each PNG. <safe> = (deck title ?? '') with every char not in [a-z0-9\s-] (case-insensitive) removed, trimmed, or 'deck' if empty. No cache-control header.

errors.when: deck row owned but no job-state blob
job state has no slide with status 'done'
done slides exist but none of their PNG blobs (new or legacy key) is readable
non-UUID deckId, DB/blob failure, embedPng on non-PNG bytes

sideEffects: void incrementExportCounts(userId, deckId) (rpc increment_export_counts; errors logged only)
externalCalls: Netlify Blobs 'deck-jobs' and 'deck-images'. No paid API.
quirks: Missing slide blobs are skipped silently (pdf-deck.ts:35) - the PDF may have fewer pages than done slides with no indication.
Slide list and versions come from job state only, not the request (pdf-deck.ts:8-12 comment).

Tile slides are NOT composited with the brand master (raw readSlideImage), unlike /api/image. The frontend comment in pdfDownload.ts:203-205 assumes server compositing; it applies to /api/image, not this route.
Filename sanitiser strips all non-ASCII (e.g. Arabic titles -> 'deck.pdf') (pdf-deck.ts:45).
getDeckTitle is queried after the PDF is built (pdf-deck.ts:44).
beforeAnyState: Deck row exists but generation never wrote job state -> 404 'Deck not found'. Job state exists but nothing done -> 400 'No finished slides to export'.

callers.expects: res.ok -> blob; any failure -> silent fallback to client-side assembly via /api/image

Does not follow redirects automatically; validates each hop. Requires non-empty body.
